confidence.supportingFactors: The product page is detailed and consistent with itself. It gives a six-day itinerary with daily meals, named activities, 2027 departure dates, the maximum group size, crew roles, vessel specifications, an all-inclusive statement, and full booking, cancellation, children and program-modification policies.
confidence.missingOrConflicting: Two conflicts: duration (six days on the product page versus 20 days / 19 nights on the homepage card) and pricing (from USD 5,900 versus 'From $ 20.000 USD'), plus an unclear per-person or per-booking basis. Missing: minimum group size, hotel name, embarkation port, arrival and departure times, kayaking and hiking metrics, supplier grading, climate data, fitness and dietary information, and explicit overnight-on-board statements for Days 2–5. The accommodation and interest taxonomies were not supplied, so those fields could not be mapped to controlled values.
confidence.accessLimitations: No pages required authentication. Only the partner's own pages were used; no third-party sources were consulted. The homepage product card is truncated.
